collection.name: pierBases
collection.doc: 🦶 Soil-structure interaction at the base of a bridge pier (EN 1998-5 Annex and EN 1998-2): the circular footing radius and the soil that give the translational and rocking springs of the foundation (Gazetas), with the shear modulus degraded for the design acceleration (EN 1998-5 Table 4.1); the checks find the period lengthening of the pier and the resulting bearing displacement.

fields.name: bridge_id
fields.doc: 🌉 Id of the bridge the pier belongs to.

fields.name: pier_id
fields.doc: 🏛 Id of the pier whose base is founded on the soil spring.

fields.name: radius_m
fields.doc: ⭕ Radius R [m] of the circular footing with the area of the real footing.

fields.name: soil_vs_m_s
fields.doc: 〰️ Small-strain shear wave velocity v_s [m/s] of the soil below the footing; G_max = ρ v_s².

fields.name: soil_unit_weight_n_m3
fields.doc: ⚖️ Unit weight γ [N/m³] of the soil below the footing; ρ = γ/g.

fields.name: poisson_ratio
fields.doc: 🔁 Poisson ratio ν of the soil below the footing.
